title: GameMetadata
description: Source-agnostic factual metadata about a cart. Lives under each games.json entry's optional `metadata` field. Any enricher (Wikidata, IGDB, MobyGames, manual curation, etc.) fills the SAME fields — downstream consumers don't care where the data came from. Designed around the filters and sorts a UI / website actually needs (see docs/FILTERS.md). All fields optional — a partial enrichment is fine and additive.

title.description: Canonical display title. May differ from the cart-DB name (which is ROM-DB-style).

alt_titles.description: Alternate names — regional retitlings, working titles, JP romanisations.

genres.description: One or more — many N64 games are multi-genre. See docs/FILTERS.md for the canonical vocabulary.

series.description: Franchise. Lets a UI group 'all Mario games' or 'all Mario Kart entries'.

release_date.description: ISO date. release_year is derived from this when both are present — keep them in sync.

region.description: Same vocabulary as cart-names.json — duplicated here so consumers don't have to cross-reference.

rating.description: Per-source aggregate scores. Keys are source IDs ('metacritic', 'gamefaqs', 'mobygames', 'igdb'); values are 0-100 normalised. Optional; enrichers fill what they can.

expansion_pak.description: Whether the cart benefits from the Expansion Pak. Surfaces a 'requires EP' filter and lets the Desktop set hardware.virtualExpansionPak intelligently.

tags.description: Freeform classifier-friendly hints (speedrun-friendly, requires-rumble-pak, has-online-play, etc.). UI uses for chips/badges.

external_ids.description: Cross-reference IDs by external database. Keys: 'wikidata', 'igdb', 'mobygames', 'gamefaqs', 'metacritic', 'thegamesdb'. Values are the ID strings as that database uses them.

enriched_from.description: Which enricher(s) populated which subset of fields. e.g. ['wikidata@2026-06-03', 'manual']. Lets a maintainer see who said what; lets a re-enrich preserve manual overrides.
